operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of records for a workflow-type entity. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

Workflow-type entities are configurable record types (for example maintenance orders or service requests). The `workflow_id` path segment selects the workflow type, and the resource prefix plus that id form the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`. Each record is a work-order-based row belonging to that type. The available fields — including any custom fields — are defined by the selected workflow type's configuration, so the record shape varies between workflow types; custom fields are returned under the `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data` object.

The trailing path segment is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page number or a response-format extension. Pagination is controlled by the `page` and `per_page` query parameters; results can be narrowed with `filter[...]`, ordered with `sort[...]`, and trimmed with `fields`.

Filter and sort act on the record's **own columns**. The fields below are an example for a maintenance-order workflow — the exact set is workflow-specific. Custom-data fields (returned under `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}_custom_data`) are **not** filterable or sortable through this endpoint.

**Filterable fields (example).** `filter[<field>]=<value>` (exact) or `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>`:

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `number` | string | `filter[number][like]=000` |
| `title` | string | `filter[title][like]=order` |
| `start_date` | date | `filter[start_date][greater_than_equal]=2026-01-01` |
| `client_id` | integer | `filter[client_id][equal]=5` |

(`filter[status]` is currently ineffective for this entity, and a `search` query parameter has no effect — use `filter[...]`.)

**Sorting.** Sort with `sort[<field>]=asc|desc` (e.g. `sort[number]=desc`) on the record's columns. The scalar `sort=field` / `sort=-field` form is not supported (HTTP 400), and no default order is guaranteed — always pass `sort[...]` for stable ordering.

parameters.name: workflow_id
parameters.description: The id of the workflow type whose records to list. Combined with the resource prefix this forms the entity key `le_workflow-type-entity-{workflow_id}`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of records per page. Defaults to `20`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter on the record's own columns, as `filter[<field>]=<value>` (exact) or `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>` (e.g. `filter[number][like]=000`). Only records matching all filters are returned. Custom-data fields are **not** filterable through this endpoint (see the endpoint description).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by a field using the bracket form `sort[<field>]=asc|desc` (e.g. `sort[number]=desc`). The scalar form `sort=field` / `sort=-field` is not supported and returns HTTP 400. No default ordering is guaranteed — pass `sort[...]` for a stable order.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in each returned record.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to `2` to return each record through the display formatter — notably file/media fields (e.g. staff photos) come back as fully-qualified URLs. The response keys are otherwise unchanged.

200.description: Paginated list of the workflow type's records.

400.description: Returned when the request cannot be processed (invalid parameter, entity not found, or the Workflow plugin is not active for the account).

401.description: The access token is missing or invalid. A permission denial (valid token, no access) instead returns `401` with an `error` field.
